summary: Genprex filed an 8-K furnishing a corporate investor presentation under Item 7.01 and announcing a new Sponsored Research Agreement with UT MD Anderson under Item 8.01. The SRA will study TROP2 and PTEN biomarkers linked to its lead candidate Reqorsa for lung cancers. This is a routine research collaboration announcement, not a M&A, tender, restructuring, or other special situation. No securities offering, corporate control change, or strategic alternative is disclosed. The registrant is the issuer reporting ordinary business developments.
